prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent automotive turning sprite atlas for an executive showroom website.
The input photograph is the identity reference. Show this exact silver Mercedes-Benz S580e L W223 (2022), preserving its paint, generation, long executive saloon body, W223 multi-projector LED headlamps, chrome horizontal grille, bonnet star, original multi-spoke wheels, dark glass, correct life-size proportions, and neutral dark-showroom reflections.
Produce ONE landscape 1536x1024 PNG with real transparent alpha. Strict grid: THREE columns and TWO rows, exactly SIX equal square cells. Each cell contains ONE complete isolated car with at least 12% clear transparent margin to all cell edges. Car must never touch or overlap a neighboring cell. No backdrop, floor, text labels, dividers or cast shadows.
Six cells in row-major order:
TOP LEFT: nose points 30 degrees toward IMAGE LEFT, body extends right, front three-quarter view.
TOP MIDDLE: nose points 15 degrees toward IMAGE LEFT, smaller visible side, front three-quarter.
TOP RIGHT: exact symmetrical HEAD-ON front, wheels straight.
BOTTOM LEFT: exact symmetrical HEAD-ON front again, same as top-right.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: nose points 15 degrees toward IMAGE RIGHT, smaller visible side.
BOTTOM RIGHT: nose points 30 degrees toward IMAGE RIGHT, body extends left, front three-quarter view.
These are fixed-camera rotation poses of the SAME car. At 15 degrees the side must be clearly LESS visible than at 30 degrees. Realistic 70mm automotive lens, camera at headlight height; never change camera elevation between cells. Every view shows the FRONT, never side-only or rear. Maintain a consistent physical vehicle height and tyre contact baseline in all cells. Gently steer the front wheels into the turning direction. The same soft realistic showroom light/reflections across all frames. White LEDs on. Elegant black plates with small white SAM and AUTOMOBILES underneath. Keep all car body edges sharp, subtle rolling softness on the wheel spokes only. No toy/render aesthetic, people, environment, smoke, flare or motion-blurred body. Transparent background is essential.
